# Polycount

> > Polycount is a community and knowledge base for game artists, focusing on 3D modeling, texturing, and physically based rendering workflows.

Polycount serves as the premier resource for game art professionals and enthusiasts, providing technical documentation on modern rendering techniques, texture workflows, and industry-standard practices for real-time 3D art creation.

## Key Topics

- PBR (Physically Based Rendering)
- RMA (Roughness/Metallic/AO)
- Channel packing
- Texture maps
- Roughness map
- Metallic map
- Ambient occlusion map
- Texturing workflows
- Photoshop
- GIMP
- Channel Shuffle
- Game art
- Real-time rendering

## PBR and Texturing Workflows

- [RMA - polycount](http://wiki.polycount.com/wiki/RMA): PBR texture channel packing guide for Roughness, Metallic, AO maps
